{{Top|leg}}
The '''agonizer''' was an experimental hand weapon developed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was specifically targeted to affect [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper's]] physiology. The weapon didn't leave any physical trauma, but caused intense pain. The pain was often so extreme that it could cause a sensory overload, killing the victim. Only a delicate neurolaser procedure could stop the effects of the agonizer.
